cues.en: Okay, so LendingClub, if you're not familiar with it, it's basically a US peer-to-peer lending company.
cues.zh: 如果不熟悉 LendingClub，它基本上是一家美國的個人對個人借貸公司。

cues.en: It's headquartered in San Francisco, California.
cues.zh: 總部位於加州舊金山。

cues.en: And what it does is it gives out loans to people, and then they have to pay back that loan with a certain interest rate.
cues.zh: 它把錢借給人們，借款人則須依一定利率償還。

cues.en: And sometimes people won't pay off that loan and the company is going to have to record that as what's known as a charge-off.
cues.zh: 有時人們沒有清償，公司就必須把它記錄成所謂的 charge-off，也就是呆帳沖銷。

cues.en: Essentially, they have to write off the loan because it wasn't paid back to them.
cues.zh: 基本上，因為借出的錢沒有還回來，必須沖銷這筆貸款。

cues.en: So, the loan status column will contain our label for this particular class.
cues.zh: 這次分類的標籤會放在 loan_status 欄。

cues.en: And we're going to try to predict based off historical data and the features of a potential customer, potential borrower, whether or not they will default on the loan.
cues.zh: 我們要根據歷史資料及潛在客戶、借款人的特徵，預測他們是否會違約。

cues.en: So, default is known as a charge-off or will they fully pay back the loan fully paid?
cues.zh: 違約在這裡記為 Charged Off，還是會全額償還，也就是 Fully Paid？

cues.en: So, keep in mind the classification metrics that you're going to be evaluating when evaluating the performance of your model.
cues.zh: 因此評估模型表現時，請留意要使用哪些分類指標。

cues.zh: 實際說明，也就是房貸帳戶數。

cues.en: And then, we'll also start dealing with categorical data.

cues.zh: 這份資料約有 395,000 筆。

cues.zh: 切分訓練測試集後，要將資料正規化，再建立模型。

cues.zh: 這裡提供部分匯入程式碼。

cues.en: You can create whatever model you feel necessary but we recommend, or the solution actually uses 78 neurons to 39 neurons, 19 neurons to 1 neuron.
cues.zh: 可以建立任何你認為合適的模型，但我們建議，或說解答使用的是 78、39、19 到 1 個神經元的結構。

cues.zh: 這完全可以自行決定。

cues.zh: 基本上有無限多種選擇。

cues.zh: 可以嘗試加入 Dropout 層等等。

cues.en: And we have links for you here to check out as well.
cues.zh: 這裡也有連結可供查看。

cues.en: So, I would recommend adding instant dropout layers.
cues.zh: 我建議加入一些 Dropout 層。

cues.en: And in the Solutions Notebook you can check that out as well.
cues.zh: 解答筆記本也有示範。

cues.en: We have this particular network structure with 0.2 or 20% dropout for each of those layers to try to prevent overfitting.
cues.zh: 我們的這個網路結構，每一層都使用 0.2，也就是 20% 的 Dropout，試著防止過度擬合。

cues.en: Then, we want you to fit that model for at least 25 epochs.
cues.zh: 然後希望你至少訓練 25 個 epoch。

cues.en: And then you'll keep going here, save the model, evaluate your model performance, see these plots.
cues.zh: 再繼續儲存模型、評估模型表現、查看這些圖。
